mapper.select: SELECT ir.IDINTERVIEW_IDX AS interviewId, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(cp.HOPE_JOB, '$[0]')) AS interviewTitle, ir.INTERVIEW_SCORE AS totalScore, ir.INTERVIEW_REASON AS aiFeedback FROM interview_result ir JOIN cover_posts cp ON ir.COVER_POSTS_IDX = cp.COVER_POSTS_IDX WHERE cp.JOBSEEKER_IDX = #{jobseekerIdx} ORDER BY ir.IDINTERVIEW_IDX DESC
